body:
## Owner decision this implements (2026-09-23)

> *"I would like the app to use alert of market opening ahead, **no automatic effect**."*

Two things make that impossible today. One of them is a dead code path.

## Defect 1 — the name-vs-window audit can never fire for the bots it was written for

`nest/src/modules/trading/session-window.ts` exports `auditNameVsWindow()` — written specifically to catch a bot whose **name** implies a session window its **config** does not declare.

Measured call sites in `nest/src/modules/automation/automation-loop.service.ts`:

| line | what |
|---|---|
| L71 | imported |
| **L1708** | **the ONLY call**, inside `logSessionSkip()` (declared L1694) |
| L1910-1912 | `logSessionSkip` is called **only** when `checkSessionWindow()` returns a **skip** |

`sessionWindow: NULL` means **ungated** (documented in `bot-rules.ts`: *"NULL = ungated (opt-in)"*), so `checkSessionWindow()` returns ok, so **no skip is logged**, so the audit **never runs**.

> **The check written to catch an unfilled slot is structurally unable to observe one.**

### The bots this missed — measured 2026-09-23

| bot | name implies | `sessionWindow` | what it did |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Sydney AUDJPY Session` | asian | **NULL** | opened AUDJPY **13:13:47** |
| `GBPCAD Macro Session` | london | **NULL** | opened GBPCAD **13:16:36** |
| `Wellington NZDJPY Session` | asian | **NULL** | held NZDJPY to 13:10 |

Both opens were **after** a manual flatten of Pepperstone at 13:10:33–13:10:45, and **14–17 minutes before the US cash open (13:30 UTC)**. The GBPCAD entry carried a signal **298 minutes old** (`trade.signalAgeAtExecutionMinutes`). Both were still open on MetaQuotes (`:5000`) afterwards; Pepperstone (`:5001`) was flat.

## Defect 2 — there is no "something important is about to happen" concept

- **`MarketSessionsService.minutesUntilOpen()` already exists** (canonical, DST-aware, has a spec) — so the mechanism is there.
- `MarketStatus` answers `open: boolean` only, and **fails closed** (`INV-GATE-FAILS-CLOSED`: if freshness cannot be verified it must return `closed`, never `open`).
- So the app can say *"closed now"* but can never say *"opens in 20 minutes"*.

## Scope

### 1. Run the audit for EVERY bot, every tick — not only on a skip
- Move or replicate the `auditNameVsWindow()` call **out of `logSessionSkip()`** so it evaluates all active bots each tick.
- Record it on the existing per-bot state — the `sessionGated` map already stores `nameWindowAgreement` and `nameWindowNote` — and keep it exposed via `GET /api/automation/status` → `sessionGatedBots`.

### 2. Raise a pre-open alert — advisory only
- Use `minutesUntilOpen()` to raise an alert when a named session (start with `ny`) is within N minutes (default 30, configurable).
- The message must name **the session**, **the minutes**, and **the positions/bots affected**.
- **NO automatic trade effect.** No gate, no close, no pause. The owner's words: *"no automatic effect."*

### 3. ⚠️ Use the ONE alert write path, and COLLAPSE

`nest/src/modules/common/alert-collapse.ts` states `collapseOrCreateAlert()` is *"the ONE write path for `alert` rows"*, and that two writers must not drift: `AlertsService.addAlert()` (CONDITION alerts) and `NotificationsService.persistAlert()` (EVENT alerts).

**Measured lesson already paid for in that file:** both used to INSERT unconditionally, producing `"1 MT5 Bridge(s) Down" ×2,210` and `R3NK P&L Alert ×4,796` while the table held 9,818 rows and the popup still said *"All clear"*.

> A per-tick pre-open alert that inserts instead of collapsing will reproduce that exactly. **An alert is an attention record, not an audit trail.**

## ⚠️ Why this is an ALERT and not a GATE — do not "fix" it into one

**#928 Part 2 measured the pre-NY-open window and it did not reach significance.** Hour 12 UTC was the weakest hour (demeaned −0.0255%, and it survived the trend control), but **t = −0.82 over 11 days**, with roughly **127 days** needed for significance. #928's own conclusion: *measure before building a rule on it.*

So an alert is justified by the observation; a **gate is not**. Raising the alert is also how the sample gets collected deliberately instead of reconstructed after the fact.

## Not in scope
- The EXIT-side session gate — that is **#928** Part 1.
- Making `sessionWindow` non-nullable — that is the **A issue**, which must come **after** this one has produced the definitive list of NULL bots.
- Any automatic flatten, pause, or entry block.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `auditNameVsWindow` fires for a bot with `sessionWindow = NULL` — **prove it with one of the three bots above**, and prove it did **not** fire before the change (canary both directions)
- [ ] An alert is raised ahead of a session open and **no trade behaviour changes** — demonstrate the same tick with and without the alert
- [ ] The alert **collapses**: run through a full window and show **ONE row**, not one per tick
- [ ] A failed or unknown session read must **not** render as "no alert pending" (absence is not a negative)
- [ ] The three NULL bots are named in the audit output
- [ ] **Gate 3:** paste the `GET /api/automation/status` output showing the audit result for a NULL bot

## Related
- **#928** — the pre-open measurement (Part 2) and the exit-side gate (Part 1)
- **#934** — roadmap sprint **S3 — Time, sessions and exits** (this belongs there)
- **#796** — standing work: make "this decision is unenforced" machine-checked
- **#826** — migrate all messaging to the notice registry (stable codes, one catalogue)
- **#933** — CLOSED: the `alert` table corruption (MySQL 1194) that made alerting unreliable
- **#851** — session/market-hours audit and consolidation (three sources each claim to be canonical)
- **#850** — the market-open gate uses the US calendar for EVERY symbol
- **#870** — annotate the create-bot fields with their enforcement status
title: Run the name-vs-session-window audit on every bot, and alert before a session open - advisory only, no automatic effect (B)
